laura: Quick heads-up — GalenSoft engagement dropped ~68% over the last 14d vs prior period. Top impacted routes: `summary-api` and `embed-bulk`. We had a renewal check yesterday and the CTO handed off to a new PM (Maya). They also ran a short POC with Aletheia Labs last week. Can we triage risk + propose next steps? cc @dmitri @ana @tom

dmitri: Thanks — can you paste the last 14d vs prior 14d numbers? also any error/latency spikes?

laura: Quick numbers from the dashboard: total calls 14d -> 2.1k, prior 14d -> 6.5k. Avg latency up ~12% on summary-api but no sustained 5xxs. Link: https://redwood.app/orgs/galensoft/dashboards/usage?range=14d

laura: SQL I ran (if helpful):
```
SELECT route, count(*) as calls
FROM events
WHERE org_id='galen' AND ts > now() - interval '28 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY calls DESC;
```

ana: ok — two quick vectors: product friction (latency/quality) and stakeholder shift (new PM evaluating alternatives). We should: 1) offer a short technical audit + run a prompt-quality check; 2) book a 30-min intro with Maya to understand success criteria; 3) propose a low-effort pilot to reestablish value. I can own the onboarding play if we get greenlight. :white_check_mark:

ana: also suggest we surface any competitive feature gaps vs Aletheia Labs (embedding latency, fine-tune options).

tom: I can take the commercial touch — propose a 2-week dedicated trial (discounted) + a joint tech session. If Maya is the decision owner, I'll ask for a quick calendar window. suggest we push a small credit ($5k) to keep them engaged.

laura: sounds good. @dmitri can you run a quick prompt-quality sweep and a short perf run on summary-api (reduce seq len / smaller batch) to see if quant or config helps?

dmitri: on it. I'll run perf A/B with current model vs q4-quant profile and capture latency/token. target to have results in ~6 hours.

renewal-bot: Reminder — GalenSoft renewal in 42 days (renewal_score: 0.46).

laura: action items: (1) dmitri -> perf + quality sweep, deliver perf numbers and 3 mitigation steps; (2) tom -> reach out to Maya and schedule 30-min commercial + tech intro; (3) ana -> prep onboarding + short pilot plan (2-week success criteria). Will update CSM tracker after calls.

tom: ping me if you want me to join the tech call. I'll loop in legal if we offer credits. :+1:

laura: thanks — I'll DM Maya to nudge for calendars. Let's sync after dmitri posts numbers.
